title: Initiative Conductor: SLI Experimentation Registry & Escalation Protocol for Error-Budget Safety
creator: Amaya Chen
description: Create an "Initiative Conductor" workflow and UI conventions to centralize SLI-focused experiments, tie them to error-budget tranches, and automate escalation/rollback signals. This ticket defines the product acceptance, operator flows, and handoffs for PM/Eng/Oncall so that SLO experiments (e.g., batching/quantization/gating changes) can be tracked, measured, and automatically gated when error-budget burn crosses thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Experiment registry exists in the Console where PM/Eng can record hypothesis, SLI definitions, baseline, and measurement windows
A2: Each experiment links to a tracked error-budget tranche and visible burn-rate chart for the last 7/30 days
A3: Automated escalation rules trigger a Slack alert and create an incident draft when burn-rate > 2x and error-budget remaining < 20% within a 1h window
A4: Rollback criteria are documented and can be executed by oncall via the Console (canary percentage rollback or model variant fallback)
A5: Experiment artifacts include links to PRs, Confluence spec, evaluation prompt sets, and test-suite results
milestones: Frontend registry MVP wired to backend events — 2026-03-18
decision_log: 2026-02-24: Decided to model experiments as first-class objects with status states (Draft / Running / Paused / Stopped) to capture lifecycle
2026-02-26: Chose burn-rate and remaining-budget dual gating instead of single-threshold to reduce false positives under bursty traffic
2026-03-01: Opted to surface P95 latency and model inference error-rate (5xx/invalid outputs) as primary SLIs for hosted API experiments
2026-03-02: Trade-off: prefer conservative automated rollbacks (human-in-loop approval window) for Dedicated customer-facing changes; fully automatic for internal infra experiments

2026-02-26 Luca Martinez: Eng design reviewed — adding fields for "injected-params" and "baseline-kv-cache-state". Need ENG-1842 to finish event hooks.

2026-03-02 Engineering note: Implemented backend schema and event API. Start ETA for frontend wiring is 2 weeks. Created draft PR #3218.
2026-03-03 Ops: Drafted escalation message templates and incident skeletons. Recommend 15-minute human approval for customer-impacting rollbacks.

risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Over-alerting from ephemeral burns could cause alert fatigue; Mitigation: require dual-condition (burn-rate + remaining budget) and a minimum sustained window (1h) before escalation
Risk: Automatic rollback may impact customers; Mitigation: default to human approval for Dedicated customers and add an emergency auto-fallback flag only for internal infra experiments
Risk: Missing signal for non-latency regressions (semantic degradation); Mitigation: require evaluation on held-out prompt sets and a basic quality check pass before experiments move to Running
